name: Aria
title: The Requiem
ability: Requiem Barrage
Channels for 2.5 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, the beam deals 15 + 100% Magic damage and applies Frost and Burn to enemies inside it.
paths: Permanent Magic growth from Stall triggers.
Amplifies Mage debuffs and adds a backup effect.
Turns the beam into a Magic and Mana Regen shield provider.
role: Back-line magic carry and dual-debuff engine
fieldNote: Protect the channel and decide early whether the run needs damage scaling, stronger debuffs, or team shielding.

name: Dragomir
title: The Executive
ability: Devour
Gains Omnivamp, then deals 250 + 200% Magic + 1000% Omnivamp damage. A kill generates Shards.
paths: Converts Shards and casts into permanent Crit and Omnivamp.
Teleports to the lowest-health enemy and chains mana on kills.
Shares Shard-driven Crit and Omnivamp with Assassins and Vanguards.
fieldNote: He needs a safe first takedown; once Devour starts converting kills into Shards, the run can compound quickly.

name: Fiona
title: The Maker
ability: Vault Spark
Applies 250 + 250% Magic Shields to the lowest-health allies; high Mana Regen increases the number of targets.
paths: Creates items and Shards after repeated casts.
Turns repeated casts into team-wide Max HP.
role: Shield support with economy and scaling branches
fieldNote: Mana Regen is both uptime and coverage. Use her path to solve economy, retaliation, or long-fight durability.

name: Funke
title: The Shackled
ability: Wildfire
Blasts every enemy in range for 175 + 200% Magic damage and applies 15 + 66% Magic Burn.
paths: Burn damage feeds Mage Magic and Funke's mana.
Adds range and timed Burn waves.
Makes casts trigger multiple Burn ticks.
fieldNote: Range is the constraint: position him so Wildfire sees the full enemy group instead of over-investing in damage that cannot connect.

name: Grace
title: The Saint
ability: Salvation
Shields and heals the lowest-health ally. After Stall 20, it can target and resurrect defeated heroes.
paths: Expands Salvation to the team after Stall.
Grants permanent class stats after late casts.
Makes Mystic shielding grant Attack and Magic.
role: Late-fight shield, healing, and resurrection support
fieldNote: Grace is strongest when the formation can survive to her Stall breakpoints; she cannot rescue a board that collapses immediately.

name: Gustav
title: The Analyst
ability: Blizzard
Creates a five-second zone that damages and Frosts enemies while shielding heroes inside it.
paths: Spends Shards on Investments that grant team Mana Regen.
Centers Blizzard on Gustav and scales Defense.
Converts casts into Shards, Mana Regen, and Magic.
fieldNote: Choose whether Gustav stays protected in the rear or becomes the center of a defensive Blizzard formation.

name: Hoyoung
title: The Newcomer
ability: Killshot
Fires at the farthest enemy for 250 + 250% Attack + 250% Magic damage with a large Crit bonus.
paths: Kill mana and permanent Mana Regen for Assassin–Mystic teams.
Front-loads Killshot Crit and rewards distance with Shards.
Always targets the farthest enemy and scales attacks by distance.
fieldNote: His farthest-target logic is a formation tool. Check which enemy will actually be selected before committing the lane.

name: Irini
title: Second Wind
ability: Limitless
Each auto attack grants Attack Speed. After Stall 15, attacks also deal Attack-Speed-scaled bonus damage.
paths: Turns total Stall and Rush triggers into spell damage.
Shares incremental Attack and Attack Speed with Duelists.
Awards the unique Zeus's Thunder quest item.
fieldNote: She needs uninterrupted attack time. A durable front line is more valuable than another fragile damage piece.

name: Kai
title: The Shotcaller
ability: Resolute Strike
Gains 300 + 400% Attack + 250% Magic Shields, then deals damage based partly on the Shields remaining after two seconds.
paths: Improves all Shields and converts new Shields into Attack.
Accelerates the strike, enlarges its area, and adds lasting Shields.
Uses Rush to guarantee Crits and shred Defense.
fieldNote: Shield timing matters more than raw armor: preserve enough of Resolute Strike's shield to make the delayed hit meaningful.

name: Karsu
title: The Finisher
ability: Snowpiercer
Fires five arrows at nearby enemies; every arrow deals mixed scaling damage and applies Frost.
paths: Permanent cast stats shared with Duelists.
Adds a Frost-inflicting arrow to every auto attack.
fieldNote: Karsu can either blanket the board with Frost or become a conventional attack-speed carry; do not split items between both plans.

name: Logan
title: The Executioner
ability: Execution
Swings for heavy Attack- and Magic-scaled damage and grows stronger by dealing damage with the ability.
paths: Turns Rush history into Warrior Attack and Defense.
Converts Execution damage into lasting Shields.
Kills refund mana and grant permanent Attack and Crit.
fieldNote: Logan wants repeated executions, not only one large hit. Mana access and safe target selection determine whether he scales.

name: Ming
title: The Drifter
ability: Inner Flame
Applies Max-HP-scaled Burn to adjacent enemies every second; Rush 5 doubles the Burn.
paths: Adds a surrounding damage, Burn, and stun cast.
Shares Max HP with Vanguards after Rush 15.
Extends Rush abilities and can grant damage immunity.
role: High-health Rush Vanguard and Burn aura
fieldNote: Ming must remain adjacent to valuable targets. Build enough durability to keep the aura active through the Rush window.

name: Niklas
title: The Dealer
ability: Red Hot Deals
After surviving combat, consumes his left-most item to permanently gain its stats and recover 80% of its value as Shards.
paths: Adds a stunning mace cast with a chance to create an item.
Adds item slots and Rush-based shielding per item.
Turns total generated Shards into retaliation damage for Vanguards and Tanks.
fieldNote: Item order is part of the build. Put only a deliberately expendable item in the left-most slot before combat.

name: Nyx
title: The Stray
ability: Ferality
Rush 5 grants stacking Attack and Attack Speed. Every 12 auto attacks refreshes all of Nyx's Rush abilities.
paths: Adds an execute threshold for Assassin and Duelist damage.
A five-hit combo that can jump and recast after a kill.
Adds Burn, Frost, and Poison to attacks at later Stall thresholds.
fieldNote: Nyx needs enough survival to reach the first refresh loop; early Attack Speed matters only if she can stay on target.

name: Pimenta
title: The Rose Knight
ability: Pepper Spray
Creates a four-second cloud that deals Magic- and Defense-scaled damage, applies Poison, and later grants HP per second.
paths: Auto attacks amplify every debuff already on the target.
Expands the cloud and shares Defense with Tanks and Mages.
Permanently grants Attack Speed to heroes directly behind her.
role: Front-line Poison Tank and formation anchor
fieldNote: The unit behind Pimenta matters as much as her own items. Align the formation so her fixed positional bonus reaches the carry.

name: Pollen
title: The Bloom
ability: Sanctuary of Bloom
Creates a five-second field that Poisons enemies, Shields allies, and begins healing after Stall 15.
paths: Doubles late healing and shielding and extends the field.
Amplifies late Poison and enemy debuffs.
Adds Frost and Burn scaling to the field.
role: Sustain field Mystic and status hub
fieldNote: Pollen rewards clustered formations. Place the team so both allies and priority enemies remain inside the field.

name: Ratna
title: The Matriarch
ability: Starfall
Deals rank-scaling Magic damage. Kills permanently grant Magic; Crits stun the full enemy team.
paths: Adds an item slot and converts item rarity into combat stats.
Shares Magic and Mana Regen with Mage–Mystic teams.
Adds extra low-health hits, kill Stealth, and permanent Crit.
fieldNote: Ratna must either secure kills or Crit reliably. Build toward one trigger first, then let the permanent growth support the other.

name: Reyna
title: The Contender
ability: Triple Threat
Performs three attack-counting punches and gains lasting Shields equal to part of the damage dealt.
paths: Converts Rush history into Attack and team Crit/Omnivamp.
Improves Triple Threat shielding and converts Shields into Attack.
Adds a frequent damage-and-Burn attack proc.
fieldNote: She scales by staying engaged. Give her enough sustain to complete repeated three-hit cycles instead of chasing only peak Attack.

name: Rip
title: The Butcher
ability: Bloodthirsty
Rush 10 grants Max-HP-scaled Attack. Health thresholds refresh Rush abilities and add Max-HP-scaled Attack Speed.
paths: Permanently gains Max HP on Rush and can share it with Vanguards.
Repeatedly stacks Max HP, Attack Speed, and Omnivamp.
Crits steal health from the target.
fieldNote: Rip wants controlled health loss, not immediate collapse. Sustain should keep him near trigger ranges without removing the payoff.

name: Rowan
title: The Anchor
ability: Hearty
After Stall 10, gains HP per second based on Max HP and Defense.
paths: Adds Fault Line: shields Rowan, damages, and stuns enemies in front.
Attacks create Max-HP Shields and deal damage from current Shields.
Permanently grows HP and Defense on Stall and shares it from backup.
fieldNote: Rowan can occupy the board or become a backup scaling engine. Decide before class modifiers split across both pools.

name: Sal
title: The Keeper
ability: Permafrost
Empowers attacks to splash a nearby enemy, deal Magic-scaled bonus damage, and apply Frost. The effect stacks.
paths: Debuff application grants Mage–Duelist Attack Speed and Magic.
Permanently grants Defense to the hero directly in front.
Allows Permafrost damage to Crit and adds Frost on Crit.
role: Short-range Frost Mage and formation support
fieldNote: Sal's two-hex range and front-facing bonus make placement unusually strict. Pair her with a deliberate front partner.

name: Skorn
title: The Bulwark
ability: Retribution
After Stall 10, being auto-attacked retaliates with Magic damage and Defense-scaled Poison.
paths: Taunts all enemies, gains Stall-scaled Shields, then returns remaining Shield as damage.
Links Poison to Frost and Frost to Shields.
Starts combat with Tank-scaled Poison and team Defense.
role: Retaliation Tank and status front line
fieldNote: Skorn needs to be targeted. Place him where enemy attacks land, then use Stall and shielding to turn pressure into output.

name: Tilly
title: The Heiress
ability: Luxurious
Cross-converts Attack and Attack Speed. Every 25 auto attacks, it generates Shards.
paths: Adds an item slot and Shard-history bonus damage.
Shares separate Rush and Stall bonuses with Warriors and Duelists.
Adds Crit and Omnivamp before an area strike.
role: Dual-class tempo carry and Shard engine
fieldNote: Her two class pools create flexibility but dilute later offers. Commit to Warrior power or Duelist speed before Rank A.

name: Yuuna
title: The Professional
ability: Shuriken Shadow Strike
Leaps and throws Crit-scaled shurikens at the lowest-health enemy for mixed Attack and Magic damage.
paths: Health loss grants Stealth, mana, and permanent Crit.
Adds a shuriken and turns kills into growing Shard income.
Crits against Poisoned targets and makes Assassin Crits apply Poison.
fieldNote: Yuuna's lowest-health targeting works best when the team can soften several enemies without accidentally pulling her into opening focus.

name: Zuri
title: The Gorgon
ability: Stone Skin
Crits permanently grant Defense and Magic a limited number of times each combat; Crit and Defense raise the trigger cap.
paths: Damages, Poisons, and stuns all enemies targeting Zuri.
Retaliates with Poison and gains HP per second.
Adds Rush and Stall attack damage and healing.
fieldNote: Zuri needs both incoming pressure and reliable Crit. Build one defensive item first so the permanent stat engine has time to work.
